$comment: Generated by scripts/build-spec.mjs from the component sources — do not edit by hand.
name: Card
import: import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardLink, CardContent, CardAction, CardFooter, CardMedia, CardAvatar } from '@theya/shadcn/ui/card';
whenToUse: A self-contained unit people scan and compare: an item in a grid, the summary of one object, a settings section.
A whole-card link or filter via `action`.

whenNotToUse.text: Only to draw a border around a page section — use space and a heading
Inside another card — use a divider or a list instead of nesting

do.caption: The whole card is the link (`action`) — one target, the biggest one.
do.example:
<Card action={{ type: 'link', href: '#seashell', ariaLabel: 'seashell.shop' }} className="w-64">
  <CardHeader divider={false}>
    <CardTitle>seashell.shop</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Active · 3 mailboxes</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
</Card>

dont.caption: A “View” button as the only way in makes people aim for a small target inside a big one.
dont.example:
<Card className="w-64">
  <CardHeader divider={false}>
    <CardTitle>seashell.shop</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Active · 3 mailboxes</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent className="pt-0">
    <Button appearance="outlined" tone="secondary" size="md">View</Button>
  </CardContent>
</Card>

do.caption: Buttons inside cards are `md`.
do.example:
<Card className="w-64">
  <CardHeader divider={false}>
    <CardTitle>Backups</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Last run 2 hours ago</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent className="flex gap-2 pt-0">
    <Button size="md">Run now</Button>
  </CardContent>
</Card>

dont.caption: Page-size buttons overpower the card they sit in.
dont.example:
<Card className="w-64">
  <CardHeader divider={false}>
    <CardTitle>Backups</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Last run 2 hours ago</CardDescription>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent className="flex gap-2 pt-0">
    <Button>Run now</Button>
    <Badge tone="success">OK</Badge>
  </CardContent>
</Card>

a11y: With `action`, give an `ariaLabel` that matches the card’s title — that’s the link’s name.
Interactive children (checkbox, menu) sit above the stretched link and stay usable.
A toned card (`tone` other than `neutral`) states its status in text too; the tint alone isn’t enough.

`effect` (tilt, spotlight, lift) reacts to the mouse only and is decoration: touch and keyboard users get the plain card, and prefers-reduced-motion turns tilt and lift off. Use it on showcase cards, not in dense product lists.

props.name: action
props.description: Primary action for the whole card. Providing one makes the card interactive automatically.

props.name: appearance
props.description: `outlined` (default) surface card, or `filled` brand card on the primary color.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Dims the card, blocks pointer events, and disables `action`/`selectable`.

props.name: effect
href
props.description: Convenience shorthand for `action={{ type: 'link', href }}`. `action` takes precedence when both are set.

props.name: selectable
props.description:
Renders a Radio or Checkbox pinned to the card's top-left corner and
reserves matching left padding on CardHeader/CardContent/CardFooter
so their content clears it. `selected`/`onSelectedChange` control
it — Card keeps no internal state and does not enforce mutual
exclusivity for `'radio'` across Cards (each Card gets its own
isolated Radix RadioGroup, purely for the checked visual); the
caller owns single-select behavior across a group of Cards.

props.name: selectLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the selection control. Required when `selectable` is set.

props.name: tone
props.description: Status tone: tinted border/surface and matching hover/focus colors. Default `neutral` (untinted).

components.name: CardHeader
components.description:
`size` overrides header spacing independently of the parent Card size
(falls back to inheriting it via group-data selectors when omitted).
`divider` explicitly enables/disables the bottom hairline; when omitted
it shows by default, dropping for the last child or an interactive card.

components.name: CardAction
components.description: A header-level control opposite the title (an icon button, a kebab menu).

props.name: height
props.description: Banner height. Defaults to 180px (on the 4px grid).

props.name: alt
props.description: `type="image"`: required alt text — announced in place of the photo.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Fill for `AvatarFallback` when using the `type` shorthand (`text`/`icon`/an image's fallback). Independent of `outline`.

props.name: fallback
props.description: `type="image"`: shown while the image loads or if it fails to load. Falls back to `initials`, then `icon`.

props.name: outline
props.description:
Ring around the avatar, drawn as two nested rings per Figma: an outer
colored ring (`'solid'` = flat `--color-border-border-primary`,
`'gradient'` = the conic sweep above) and, inside it, a background-color
separator ring so the colored ring doesn't sit flush against the photo.
`'none'` (not in Figma's variant set, added for flexibility) skips both
and lets `AvatarImage`/`AvatarFallback` fill the full shape.

props.name: separator
props.description:
The background-color separator ring between the colored `outline` ring
and the content (Figma's `innerOutline`). On by default; set `false` to
let the colored ring sit flush against the photo/fallback instead. No
effect when `outline="none"`.

props.name: type
props.description:
Shorthand for Figma's Type variant — renders the matching content
(`icon`/`src`+`alt`/`initials` below) without composing
`AvatarImage`/`AvatarFallback` by hand. Omit `type` and pass
`AvatarImage`/`AvatarFallback`/`AvatarBadge` as `children` directly for
full control (e.g. a custom fallback delay, or a badge).
